p: Kings Heath's High Street is one of south Birmingham's liveliest shopping strips, and this 18+ MERKUR at Scots Corner is right on it. Buses run along the main road into Birmingham city centre all day, so you don't need to bring the car.

The area is known for its independent cafés, bars and restaurants, and the Hare & Hounds pub is a much-loved music venue, famous as the place UB40 played their first gig. Kings Heath Park has lovely planting and a café, and Highbury Park is close by too if you fancy a longer walk.
